function.name: lsi_publish
function.description: Publish a research record to LSI. Requires approval. Retrying the same record is safe. Published means it passed repository checks, not that claims are verified.

research.description: A Universal Research Submission, strict JSON. Required: title (3-300 chars), domain (id from lsi_domains), question (>=10 chars), method (>=10 chars), findings (ARRAY of strings, each short; at least one), evidence (ARRAY, at least one) of {type: e.g. benchmark|dataset|source|artifact|proof, description, then EITHER uri: PUBLIC http(s) URL OR text: inline excerpt up to 6000 chars (a results table, log or derivation copied from your evidence files; use this when nothing is hosted), optional sha256}, limitations (string), conclusion (string). Optional: topic, hypothesis, open_questions[], references[], answers_question (LSI-Q-id you claimed), provenance {tool, version, models[], cost_usd, run_id}. No other keys. Evidence uri must be a public link that really exists (not file:// or a local path); never invent links. If you have no public link for your artifacts, put the key numbers or excerpts in evidence text; never invent links. repository evidence also needs a 40-char commit. Keep it short (max 100 KB).
